model_type: Identity-preserving AI photo generation and editing

technology_stack.foundation: Identity-preserving diffusion model (Nano Banana / Gemini 3 Pro Image)
technology_stack.core_mechanic: Private per-person profile training from 30-50 photos
technology_stack.identity_preservation: Bone structure, expressions, features locked via profile_id

generate.description: Create new photographs from text prompt + profile references

edit.description: Modify existing photographs while preserving identity
use_cases: Group shot compositing from separate photos

enhance.description: Automatic quality improvement with no prompt required

prompt.description: Text prompt with [[profile_id]] references inline. In Generate mode: full creative brief. In Edit mode: what to keep + what to change.
prompt.profile_syntax: [[profile_id]] — double brackets around the trained profile identifier
prompt.critical_note: Profile must be explicitly referenced in prompt text. Uploading a profile does NOT activate it.

aspect_ratio.notes: Auto derives from input image in Edit mode

resolution.notes: 4K available for premium output; must be explicitly set

num_images.description: Number of images to generate per request

sync_mode.notes: True returns data URI; output won't appear in history

input_images.type: array of image URLs or base64
input_images.description: 1+ source images for editing or compositing

prompt.notes: No prompt needed for Enhance mode

training_images.format: ZIP archive uploaded via image_data_url parameter
training_images.privacy: Private — not shared with other users or used for public model training

include: Multiple angles: full frontal, 3/4 turn, profile view
Multiple lighting: natural daylight, indoor, overcast, studio
Multiple expressions: neutral, smiling, pensive, animated
Varied framing: tight headshots, shoulder-up, waist-up
avoid: Heavy filters or strong color grading
Deep shadow on face or strong backlight obscuring features
Sunglasses, hats, or accessories covering the face
Extremely distant shots where face is tiny in frame
Identical photos of same pose/lighting — variety is critical
photo_requirements.group_photos_note: Acceptable — Phota trains on the person who appears most often across uploaded images. For best results, upload solo photos only.

profile_reference.description: Double-bracket reference to trained identity profile. MUST be included in prompt text for identity preservation to activate.
profile_reference.multi_person: [[id1]] and [[id2]] — reference multiple profiles in one prompt for group shots
profile_reference.critical_rule: Uploading a profile does NOT activate it. Must be called with [[profile_id]] in every request.

identity_lock_phrases.prevent_face_drift: Preserve identity and facial features exactly
identity_lock_phrases.lock_pose: Keep camera angle and crop the same
identity_lock_phrases.lock_composition: Preserve the original framing and background
identity_lock_phrases.lock_expression: Keep the same expression, modify only [X]
identity_lock_phrases.natural_output: Photoreal, no plastic smoothing, no over-retouching

negative_prompts.alternative: Use positive constraint language instead of negative exclusions

generate_mode.example: Professional studio headshot of [[profile_id_1]], chest up. Soft key light from upper left, subtle rim light on hair. Confident expression, direct gaze. 85mm lens look, shallow depth of field. Clean neutral gray background.

edit_mode.formula: Keep [identity/pose/framing] unchanged. [Change only this specific thing.]
edit_mode.example: Keep the same person and identity exactly. Adjust only the facial expression: soften into a natural relaxed smile. Preserve lighting and background.

professional_headshot.prompt_emphasis: Studio lighting recipe, 85mm lens feel, clean background, expression

social_media_portrait.prompt_emphasis: Environmental setting, natural light, lifestyle feel

expression_fix.prompt_emphasis: Lock everything, change only expression. One fix per pass.

group_shot_composite.prompt_emphasis: Reference both profiles. Match lighting of primary image. Natural integration.

memory_rescue.prompt_emphasis: Profile locks identity from degraded source. Fix quality issues in prompt.

album_consistency.prompt_emphasis: No prompt — auto quality improvement across entire album

identity_not_preserved.problem: Output doesn't look like the person

wrong_person_generated.problem: Profile generates a different person than intended
wrong_person_generated.cause: Training photos were group shots — Phota trained on majority person
wrong_person_generated.solution: Retrain with solo photos of the intended subject only

identity_drift_between_edits.problem: Person's appearance shifts across multiple edits
identity_drift_between_edits.cause: Too many changes stacked in one prompt
identity_drift_between_edits.solution: One change per pass. Always include identity lock phrases.

generic_output.problem: Output looks generic, not like professional photography
generic_output.cause: Vague style words without photographic specifics
generic_output.solution: Replace 'cinematic' with actual lighting recipe: direction, quality, color temperature

awkward_expression.solution: Add explicit expression: 'warm natural smile,' 'confident, direct gaze'

composited_group_looks_fake.problem: Multi-person shot looks like people were pasted together
composited_group_looks_fake.solution: Add 'Match lighting and perspective of Image 1' to edit prompt

resolution_too_low.solution: Explicitly set resolution to '4K' in API call
